mutants.description: The target test checks for equality instead of at-or-past, so a ceiling already above a lowered max_on_limit is never clamped back down (the bug the header says >= was brought in to fix).
mutants.reason: If max_on_limit is written below the present ceiling during S_SS, max_on_counts keeps stepping up past the limit, runs to the top of its range and wraps, and SS_done is not asserted when it should be.

mutants.description: The ramp step is an independent if after the at-target clamp rather than its else branch, so on a step boundary the later step assignment wins over the clamp.
mutants.reason: In S_SS, with the ceiling at or above max_on_limit (for example after the limit is lowered mid-ramp), a pwm_fall that ends a step window drives max_on_counts to one above the ceiling, so it sits above max_on_limit for one clock before the clamp takes effect.

mutants.description: The at-target clamp and SS_done are only acted on at a PWM falling edge, as if they were a ceiling update that has to wait for the pulse to end, instead of on any clock.
mutants.reason: When max_on_limit equals the floor, SS_done comes at the first falling edge of the PWM instead of on the first clock of S_SS. A limit lowered below the ceiling mid-ramp is likewise not clamped onto max_on_counts until the next falling edge.

mutants.description: The step-window counter advances on every clock while the PWM is high, not once per switching cycle at the falling edge.
mutants.reason: In S_SS cycle_counter counts on-time clocks, so whether it equals cycles_per_step-1 at a falling edge depends on the pulse width. max_on_counts then steps at the wrong cycles, or not at all, instead of once every cycles_per_step cycles.

mutants.description: The hold condition also keeps the ceiling while SS_done is set, so a completed ramp is not reset to the floor when the supervisor leaves S_RUN for hiccup or idle.
mutants.reason: After S_RUN, when both ss_active and run_active are low, max_on_counts stays at max_on_limit and SS_done stays high. The next S_SS then finishes at once at full ceiling instead of re-ramping from MIN_ON_COUNTS.

mutants.description: Outside S_SS and S_RUN the ceiling is only reset to the floor if the ramp had finished, so a soft start aborted mid-ramp leaves its partial ceiling in place.
mutants.reason: If ss_active drops before SS_done (for example a hiccup during soft start), max_on_counts keeps its partial value. The retry's S_SS then starts its ramp from that value instead of from MIN_ON_COUNTS.
